hijab.definition:
n. a headscarf worn by Muslim women; conceals the hair and neck and usually has a face veil that covers the face
n. the custom in some Islamic societies of women dressing modestly outside the home
hijab.translation: n. 穆斯林妇女戴的面纱或头巾

hijack.definition:
n. seizure of a vehicle in transit either to rob it or divert it to an alternate destination
v. seize control of
hijack.translation:
vt. 抢劫, 劫持, 敲诈
[法] 挡路抢劫, 抢劫, 绑架

hijacked.definition:
v take arbitrarily or by force
v seize control of
hijacked.translation: v. 劫持( hijack的过去式和过去分词 ); 绑架; 拦路抢劫; 操纵（会议等, 以推销自己的意图）

hijackee.translation: 劫持事件的受害者, 被劫持者

hijacker.definition:
n a holdup man who stops a vehicle and steals from it
n someone who uses force to take over a vehicle (especially an airplane) in order to reach an alternative destination
hijacker.translation:
n. 强盗, 劫盗, 劫持犯
[法] 劫持者, 绑架者, 抢劫者

hijackers.definition:
n. a holdup man who stops a vehicle and steals from it
n. someone who uses force to take over a vehicle (especially an airplane) in order to reach an alternative destination
hijackers.translation: n. 抢劫者, 劫持者( hijacker的复数形式 )

hijacking.definition:
n robbery of a traveller or vehicle in transit or seizing control of a vehicle by the use of force
v take arbitrarily or by force
v seize control of

hijackings.definition:
plural of hijacking

v seize control of
hijackings.translation: (hijacking 的复数) [法] 劫持, 绑架

hijacks.definition:

hijacks.translation:

hijaz.definition: n a coastal region of the western Arabian Peninsula bordering on the Red Sea; includes both Mecca and Medina; formerly an independent kingdom until it united with Nejd to form the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

hijra.translation: n. 逃亡;  （印度的）中性人

plural of hijra
n. See Hegira.
hijras.translation: (hijra 的复数) n. 逃亡;  （印度的）中性人
